text:
cora: FYI — PartnerSupport sent a shared Google Drive doc and I spotted what looks like a Redwood API secret in a spreadsheet row: `REDWOOD_SECRET=sk_live_...`
alex: can you drop the exact snippet (mask the middle) and which env it references?
cora: masked: `sk_live_<redacted>` in a sheet titled 'staging-access-2026'. file is shared with partner@vendor.com
jin: is this a long-lived service token or a per-user key? any associated metadata in the sheet?
cora: no metadata, just the token string and a note "for debugging webhooks". looks like staging but could be prod if someone copy/pasted wrong.
sec-bot: Alert: Automated secret scanner found public/external share containing value matching API key pattern. Confidence: high. Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/xxxx (access logged)
maria: ok immediate steps: 1) rotate the key 2) block any active sessions 3) search logs for use 4) notify partner comms. who can rotate now?
alex: I can rotate. rotina: create new key via internal admin -> revoke old -> update KMS mapping if needed. I'll do in 10m and post new key to vault.
jin: before rotation: run quick query for last 30d token usage: `SELECT count(*) FROM api_logs WHERE token LIKE 'sk_live_%' GROUP BY project` — ops to help with logs retention
ops-bot: Running query on logs (this may take up to 2m). ETA: 90s.
ops-bot: Query results: token seen 3 unique IPs in last 7 days, all from our CI pool. No requests to production-only endpoints observed so far.
maria: good. alex rotate and revoke. also check audit logs for vault access and KMS decrypt ops.
alex: rotated and revoked old key. new key created and pushed to vault path: `secret/redwood/staging/apikeys/debug` — old key disabled at 2026-03-20T16:12:10Z
cora: confirmed partner no longer has access to the old doc (I removed external share), sent them a heads-up and asked to delete any copies.
jin: follow-up: add an ACL check and detection rule to flag docs with `sk_live_` pattern in Drive shares to partners.
maria: add RBAC note: ensure service tokens have least-privilege and short TTLs. also add to post-incident: rotate any token that appeared in external share even if no prod access.
sec-bot: I created incident INC-2026-0423 for tracking and will attach logs and rotation timestamps.
alex: action items assigned: alex (rotate & revoke) done, jin (detection rule) assigned, cora (partner comms) done, maria (post-incident docs + runbook update) assigned. ETA EOD.
maria: please also run KMS audit: show decrypt ops for the old key id between 03/01 and today; attach to incident.
ops-bot: KMS audit pulled, attaching summary to INC-2026-0423. No external KMS decrypts outside our projects.
cora: closing note: no customer data exfil detected in logs. will keep incident open 72h for monitoring.
alex: thanks all — will follow up if anything else shows up. :thumbsup:
